azure-arc-sql-server-developer-free.title: Non-production SQL Server can use the free Developer edition
azure-arc-sql-server-developer-free.body: This is a non-production estimate that pays for SQL Server Standard, Enterprise or Web through Azure Arc pay-as-you-go. Microsoft says the Developer edition is free and is reported through Azure Arc with a $0 meter, so development and test machines may not need to pay for a production edition.

citation.source: Manage licensing and billing of SQL Server enabled by Azure Arc
citation.quote: The SQL Server Developer edition is free and can be used in any Azure subscription.
